evidence: dx/d3d8.cpp handlers and D3D8-specific COM lifetime hooks do not invoke guest callbacks; com_ret writes guest EAX, imports_dispatch adjusts ESP, and other GPRs and arithmetic flags retain their guest values. Reads remain conservative.
dx/d3d8_fpu.h contains the only D3D8 guest CW update; only CreateDevice carries a CW effect. Unsupported methods terminate with named diagnostics.
D3D9 methods remain unknown unless explicitly audited below; device lifecycle can invoke guest window procedures and D3DX lifetime paths can invoke guest state managers.

dx/dsound.cpp COM method tables dispatch to native handlers and COM lifetime hooks without guest callbacks or guest CPU writes beyond com_ret; DirectSoundEnumerate callbacks are separate DLL exports, outside this family. dx/com.h com_ret writes EAX and runtime/imports.cpp performs the stdcall ESP adjustment. Other GPRs and arithmetic flags retain their guest values; reads remain conservative.
D3DX9 effect methods remain unaudited; dx/d3d9.cpp effect application and destruction invoke guest ID3DXEffectStateManager methods through guest_call.
D3D8 CreateDevice changes PC/RC unless D3DCREATE_FPU_PRESERVE; early returns precede the control-word update, so only the fixed bits are asserted

dx/d3d9.cpp Dev_SetVertexShaderConstantF validates guest memory and copies constants to the native device bridge; bridge_result and com_ret write EAX without guest callbacks. runtime/imports.cpp adjusts ESP; other GPRs and arithmetic flags are unchanged.

dx/d3d9.cpp Dev_SetPixelShaderConstantF validates guest memory and copies constants to the native device bridge; bridge_result and com_ret write EAX without guest callbacks. runtime/imports.cpp adjusts ESP; other GPRs and arithmetic flags are unchanged.
